n-midterm-democrats-coins.title: Democrats win Congress coins
n-midterm-democrats-coins.summary: Coins named for the 2026 US midterm result and Trump's reaction. News outlets on X report that Democrats won the House and the Senate on 2026-11-04 (Reuters, BNO News, Watcher.Guru), and that Trump, who had said on 2026-11-01 he would become "Mr. Veto" if Democrats won Congress (Newsmax), posted a red hat reading "VETO" on Truth Social (Fox News, CTV News, 2026-11-04). Mr. Veto (VETO, Pump.fun): "President Trump lays out his strategy for dealing with a potential Democratic-controlled Congress." Mr Veto (VETO, Pump.fun) has no description; its name is Trump's line. Democratic Party (DEM, Pump.fun): "Watcher.Guru posted about the U.S. Democratic Party taking both the House and Senate". The Democrat Cat (Democat, Pump.fun): "...lead Democrats to victory." None of the coins is shown to be connected to any party, campaign or official. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

summaries.n-anthropic-ipo: Coins named for Anthropic's planned stock listing. Anthropic (ANT, Pump.fun): "$ANT The Meme Stock for the Anthropic IPO". Anthropic (ANT, StonkFun): "The Anthropic Ant." Anthropic (ANTS, Pump.fun): "As Anthropic eyes Wall Street, Ant Group dons a suit." Three more coins named Anthropic (Clanker V4: one on Base, 0xfff156..., and two on Robinhood Chain, 0xcee339... and 0xf289e2...) have no description; their name is the story. Posts of 2026-10-26 from Cointelegraph, The Kobeissi Letter and Wall Street Engine report that Anthropic filed an S-1 seeking a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT, and later posts report an amended S-1 and an IPO website. Dates from Codex: the ANT pool on StonkFun opened 2026-09-11, the ANT pool on Pump.fun 2026-10-19 and the ANTS pool on Pump.fun 2026-10-31 (after the filing); the Base Anthropic pool (0xfff156...) opened on 2026-11-02, the Robinhood Chain pool 0xcee339... on 2026-11-03 and 0xf289e2... on 2026-11-04, all after it. The descriptions are the coins' own; none of the coins is shown to be connected to Anthropic. The Base coin 0xfff156... is archived (under $1,000 of volume two days running). The first Base coin (0xf7b9cf...) is archived.
